PREFIX net: <http://example.org/network#>
SELECT ?alarm (COUNT(?causedAlarm) AS ?preventedCount) WHERE {
  ?alarm net:causallyLinkedTo ?causedAlarm .
}
GROUP BY ?alarm
ORDER BY DESC(?preventedCount)
LIMIT 1
